alex: Quick heads up — quant8x4 bring-up is showing a small but consistent quality regression on our summarization promptset (~4.2% drop in ROUGE-L on eval/2026-03-18/q8-bridge). Rooted failures seem to be: hallucination on long bullets, truncated lists, and some formatting loss on numbered outputs. :thinking_face:
mina: ack. Do we have the top failing prompts to triage pattern?
alex: Pasting the top 10 failure IDs in a sec. If anyone wants raw queries:```sql
SELECT id, prompt, metric_diff, failure_note
FROM eval_failures
WHERE eval_id='eval/2026-03-18/q8-bridge'
ORDER BY metric_diff DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
alex: Top examples show a lot of near-duplicates and multi-turn snippets that hit the 4k->8k truncation boundary in quantized run.
chris: I'll spin up a relabel batch for the top 200 failures. We should dedupe first — otherwise labelers will see repeat tasks.
sarah: For dedupe use the new fingerprint pipeline: `ingest/fingerprint_v2 --source=eval_failures --thres=0.88 --out=tmp/dedupe.tsv`. That preserves context hashes so we don't accidentally merge different turns.
chris: perfect. After dedupe I'll route to the "quant-bridge-relabel" queue and set a priority tag. Expected throughput 40/hr so should finish in ~5hrs.
mina: Also let's run a quick quant-smoke with 16-bit mixed fallback on the few long ones to check whether it's pure kernel instability or quant noise. Command I used: ```bash
./bench/compare_models.sh --base=float16 --target=quant8x4 --prompt-file=tmp/top200.txt --metrics=rouge,exact,format-preserve
```
alex: good plan. If the relabel shows label drift (accept vs reject patterns changed) we should consider augmenting golden set with 50 high-divergence cases and pin them for the rollout canary.
chris: will mark 50 candidate golds and submit a tiny canary eval. tagging now: `goldset:add --ids=tmp/high_divergence_ids.csv --reason="quant8x4 regressions"`
annotator-bot: created task batch 3421 -> quant-bridge-relabel (200 items). ETA 5h.
sarah: FYI infra — I'll reserve a small dedicated slot on the canary pool tonight so we don't get noisy fallbacks.
mina: timeline check — can we have relabel results + smoke by EOD PST?
chris: yes, I'll push updates to this thread as labels complete. First 50 should be done in ~2h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
alex: thanks all. If we see formatting-specific fails, I'll prepare a prompt-engineering patch and a manual regression test. For now main blockers: dedupe -> relabel -> small goldset augment -> canary smoke.
mina: ping me if you want me to convert any failing cases into structured test items (JSON with expected fields).
chris: noted. starting dedupe now. :rocket:
